arguments.sql_query: SELECT concept_id, concept_name, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id FROM omop.concept WHERE domain_id = 'Drug' AND standard_concept = 'S' AND concept_class_id = 'Ingredient' AND (LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%albuterol%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%salbutamol%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%levalbuterol%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%ipratropium%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%terbutaline%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%metaproterenol%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%pirbuterol%') ORDER BY concept_name

WITH asthma_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT co.person_id
    FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
    JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca
      ON ca.descendant_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
    WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 317009
), rescue_ingredients AS (
    SELECT concept_id, concept_name
    FROM omop.concept
    WHERE concept_id IN (1154343,1192218,1112921,1236744,1123995,1125449)
), rescue_exposures AS (
    SELECT de.person_id, de.drug_exposure_id, de.drug_concept_id,
           ri.concept_id AS ingredient_concept_id,
           ri.concept_name AS ingredient_name
    FROM omop.drug_exposure de
    JOIN asthma_patients ap ON ap.person_id = de.person_id
    JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca
      ON ca.descendant_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
    JOIN rescue_ingredients ri
      ON ri.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
)
SELECT ingredient_name AS rescue_medication,
       COUNT(*) AS dispensing_records,
       COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS patients_dispensed,
       COUNT(DISTINCT drug_concept_id) AS distinct_drug_concepts
FROM rescue_exposures
GROUP BY ingredient_name
ORDER BY dispensing_records DESC;
